scenario_description:
Objective: Reduce the chance of a missed hand-signal during Magnolia Arts Center's after-dark inverter cart move.
Emerging Need: Routine night work becomes risky when substitute crew participation and a noisy fan-house overlap, but the brief ground-stage window is not visible until later.
Decision Context: Early schedule and roster updates alone do not justify adding training; the relevant site note identifies why a bilingual signal review matters and when it must occur.
Consequence: If the ground window closes without preparation, the crew may begin the first rooftop handoff without a shared signal set, increasing the chance of a preventable handling incident.

parameter.title: Magnolia Arts Center north-roof inverter swap
parameter.description: After-dark municipal roof work for replacing two inverter carts on the north roof. Current safety packet and fall-protection records are marked current.

parameter.subject: Magnolia Wednesday roster substitution
parameter.body: VoltPro is sending Luz Caro and Mateo Ibarra in place of Dana and Will for Wednesday evening. Both are current on Suntrail orientation and fall-protection cards; neither has worked the Magnolia north roof before. They prefer Spanish-language field briefings when available. No roster paperwork gaps on our side.

parameter.content: Facilities moved north fan-house recommissioning into the same Wednesday evening block. Expect turbine noise along the inverter-cart path; verbal calls may not carry cleanly during the first cart move.

parameter.title: Magnolia secure-roof shuttle staging
parameter.description: Only all-hands ground-stage window with subcontractor crew before phones are bagged and the shuttle departs to the secure loading level. Dispatch packet agenda can be edited until 14:30 Wednesday.
parameter.location: Magnolia Arts Center south loading gate

parameter.content: Magnolia shuttle has departed and phones are bagged for the secure roof. The first inverter cart handoff starts as soon as we unload, and there is no remaining ground-stage huddle time.
